name: branding-olive-folder-and-square-feed-preview-cover
title: Olive folder title card pointing to a 3x3 nature feed on a darkened forest field
whatItIs: A darkened landscape of trees and a grassy field. On the left an olive folder-shaped card carries 'APPOINTMENT' and a Ukrainian subtitle; an arrow points to a 3x3 feed grid of green-toned posts. Tiny header labels sit across the top.
whatItMeans: Grounded, calm and organic; the folder plus arrow shows brand and result at a glance.
techniques: Turn a folder shape into a title card.
Point with an arrow to the resulting feed grid.
Use a darkened natural photo as backdrop.
Keep the palette to olive, cream and forest green.

vocabulary.definition: A card shaped like a file folder holding a title.
A grid of finished posts shown as outcome.
An arrow connecting cause and result.
A photo dimmed so foreground shapes pop.
